name: Narendra Modi
text: Start-ups have a huge opportunity for collaboration with small local businesses. Start-ups can empower and make these local businesses efficient.

name: Satya Nadella
text: Nadella described digital infrastructure, connectivity and AI as an opportunity to improve productivity, including for small businesses, while extending technological benefits across countries.

name: Sundar Pichai
text: Pichai called for broader connectivity, financial inclusion and digital skills, highlighting the importance of giving small businesses access to digital tools and opportunities to grow across borders.

name: Muhammad Yunus
role: Founder, Grameen Bank · 2006 Nobel Peace Prize laureate
text: In a lecture on social business and microcredit, Yunus discussed empowering women and reducing poverty, describing how encouragement and access to small loans can help people take their first steps in business.
event: Social Business and Microcredit for Women’s Empowerment and Poverty Alleviation · Georgetown University

name: Jack Ma
text: At the launch of the Enabling E-commerce initiative, Ma advocated a more inclusive global marketplace in which small businesses, young people and developing countries can participate and succeed.
event: Enabling E-commerce initiative launch · Buenos Aires
